caption: The drawing depicts a metal lantern with a cylindrical body and a conical top perforated with rows of circular holes for ventilation. The lantern has a prominent ring handle attached at the peak of the conical top. On the front of the lantern is a rectangular door with a glass pane, shown in a slightly open position, revealing hinges on the left and a latch on the right. On each side of the main door are two narrow panels that are also open, suggesting they may serve as additional access points or vents. The illustration is in shades of grey and black, rendered with graphite or pencil, giving it a monochrome appearance. The lantern sits within a lightly sketched rectangular border, and in the lower left corner, the words "1 INCH" are written as a scale reference. The artist's signature is present in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
